menus.note: Lunch or dinner. Newer dishes; choice of main and dessert. Wine pairing €65, sake pairing €70, beer pairing €30.

menus.name: Clásicos del Bunker menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner. The restaurant's best-known dishes; choice of main and dessert. Wine pairing €65, sake €70, beer €30; A5 wagyu tataki €37 extra.

bookingOpens: Online through CoverManager on the restaurant's website, or by phone or WhatsApp. A card may be needed to secure the booking.
groups: Two private rooms, the upstairs izakaya and the downstairs bunker, each seat 15 for private and corporate events; ask through the events page.
